name: Kobold Style
text:
**Kobold Style** (Combat, Style)

You’re able to manipulate foes that are caught off guard.

**Prerequisites**: Combat Expertise, Small size or smaller.

**Benefit**: You gain a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks
 against enemies denied their Dexterity bonus to AC.
